description: ViewModel for managing the state of the portfolio UI in a cryptocurrency tracker app, handling user portfolio data and interacting with repositories to load and update portfolio items.

classes.name: PortfolioViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class that manages the portfolio data and state for the UI.

classes.name: PortfolioUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different states of the portfolio UI including loading, success, and error states.

classes.name: PortfolioItemUi
classes.description: Data class representing an item in the user's portfolio including its details.

methods.name: loadPortfolio
methods.description: Loads the portfolio data and updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: addPortfolioItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the user's portfolio and updates the UI state.
